title: Local mass vanishes on a set that misses the support (parent step 1 and preliminary (p1))
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U, V ⊆ ℝ^P be arbitrary sets and let T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) be a current in U (SimonGMT GeometricCurrentOn U n). Suppose V ∩ spt T = ∅, where spt T = GeometricCurrentOn.support T is U minus the union of the open sets W with closure(W) compact, closure(W) ⊆ U and T(η) = 0 for every η ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) with tsupport η ⊆ W. Then M_V(T) = 0. Here M_V(T) = T.massOn V is the supremum in [0, ∞] of ofReal(T(ω)) over the forms ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ V and Euclidean coefficient norm |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for every x.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U V : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), Disjoint V T.support → T.massOn V = 0
